title: Audiovisual Equipment Installers and Repairers
description: Install, repair, or adjust audio or television receivers, stereo systems, camcorders, video systems, or other electronic entertainment equipment in homes or other venues. May perform routine maintenance.

tasks.text: Install, service, and repair electronic equipment or instruments such as televisions, radios, and videocassette recorders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on electronic equipment repair

tasks.text: Calibrate and test equipment, and locate circuit and component faults, using hand and power tools and measuring and testing instruments such as resistance meters and oscilloscopes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical probing and meter work by hand

dwas.name: Test electrical circuits or components for proper functioning.

tasks.text: Confer with customers to determine the nature of problems or to explain repairs.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Assessing customer problems needs live diagnostic dialogue

dwas.name: Confer with customers or users to assess problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Position or mount speakers, and wire speakers to consoles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Installing AV equipment requires hands-on wiring

tasks.text: Instruct customers on the safe and proper use of equipment.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Customer product training is relational and situational

dwas.name: Train customers in the use of products.

tasks.text: Make service calls to repair units in customers' homes, or return units to shops for major repairs.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical travel to sites requires human mobility

dwas.name: Travel to work sites to perform installation, repair or maintenance work.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Read and interpret electronic circuit diagrams, function block diagrams, specifications, engineering drawings, and service manuals.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Technical reading for maintenance well handled

dwas.name: Read technical information needed to perform maintenance or repairs.
Interpret blueprints, specifications, or diagrams to inform installation, development or operation activities.

tasks.text: Tune or adjust equipment and instruments to obtain optimum visual or auditory reception, according to specifications, manuals, and drawings.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Keep records of work orders and test and maintenance reports.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Log maintenance and repair records from data

tasks.text: Disassemble entertainment equipment and repair or replace loose, worn, or defective components and wiring, using hand tools and soldering irons.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on electronic equipment repair

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.

tasks.text: Compute cost estimates for labor and materials.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Labor/material cost estimation from rates

dwas.name: Estimate costs for labor or materials.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information
